fine_lines.title: used to vs past simple
fine_lines.explanation_ar: used to لعادة أو حالة كانت في الماضي ولم تعد (You used to have long hair). الماضي البسيط لحدث واحد انتهى (I ran a half-marathon last year).
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Used to" = a past habit or state that is not true now. Past simple = one finished event.

examples.sentence: You used to have long hair.
I ran a half-marathon last year.

fine_lines.title: still vs not anymore
fine_lines.explanation_ar: still تعني ما زال (Do you still run?). not ... anymore تعني لم يعد.

expressions.phrase: Excuse me, but I think you're sitting in my seat.
expressions.meaning_ar: عفوًا، أظن أنك تجلس في مقعدي.
expressions.meaning_en: Politely tell someone they are in your seat.
expressions.example: Excuse me, but I think you're sitting in my seat.
Oh, sorry about that. Here you are.

expressions.meaning_en: Say you didn't expect to see someone.
An informal greeting after a long time.
expressions.example: Long time no see! How are you?
You look different now. You have glasses.

expressions.phrase: What have you been up to since graduation?
expressions.meaning_en: Ask about someone's life since school.
expressions.example: What have you been up to since graduation?

expressions.meaning_en: Ask someone's opinion about their job or place.
expressions.example: You're a nurse now? How do you like it?

expressions.meaning_en: Describe a hard but good experience.
expressions.example: My new job has been challenging but rewarding.

expressions.phrase: Do you still keep in touch with any of our high school friends?

expressions.example: Do you still keep in touch with your old classmates?

expressions.phrase: Let's organize a dinner and invite everyone.
expressions.example: Let's organize a dinner and invite everyone.

grammar.title: used to + verb for past habits
grammar.explanation_ar: used to + الفعل في أصله لعادة أو حالة في الماضي لم تعد: You used to have long hair. I don't play as much as I used to.
grammar.explanation_en: used to + base verb = a past habit or state that has changed.
examples: You used to have long hair in high school.
Not as much as I used to.
I used to live near the school.

grammar.title: Present perfect continuous: I've been working...
grammar.explanation_ar: have been + فعل بـ ing لشيء بدأ في الماضي وما زال مستمرًا: I've been working as a nurse for the past few years.
grammar.explanation_en: have been + verb-ing for something that started in the past and continues now.
examples: I've been working as a nurse for the past few years.
What have you been up to?

grammar.title: Comparatives: shorter, more muscular
grammar.explanation_ar: لمقارنة الحاضر بالماضي: صفة قصيرة + er (short → shorter)، وصفة طويلة more + الصفة (more professional).
grammar.explanation_en: Short adjectives + -er (shorter). Long adjectives: more + adjective (more professional).
examples: Glasses make me look more professional.
